title: Register a student
want: register a student with a unique roll number
benefit: fee and examination records refer to one reliable identity
fr: The system shall register a student with a unique case-insensitive roll number, name, email and programme.
criteria: Valid roll number, name, email and programme create one active student with a stable numeric ID.
A roll number that already exists, ignoring letter case and surrounding spaces, is rejected without adding a record.
Missing required values or an invalid email are rejected with a field-specific message.
The new record remains retrievable after closing and reopening the database.
tasks: Implement registration form, validation and persistent student storage
Test valid registration, invalid fields and duplicate roll numbers; review the code

title: Search and view students
benefit: I can identify the correct student before handling fees or examinations
fr: The system shall search students by roll number or name and display their identity, programme and status.
criteria: An exact roll-number search returns the matching record.
A partial name search is case-insensitive and returns matching students.
A query without matches displays an empty-result message and does not change data.
The result shows ID, roll number, name, email, programme and active/inactive status.
tasks: Implement student search and record display
Test matching, empty results and safe handling of special characters; review the code

title: Update student contact and programme details
want: correct a student's name, email or programme
fr: The system shall update a student's name, email and programme while preserving ID and roll number.
criteria: Valid replacement name, email and programme are saved for the selected student.
The student's numeric ID and roll number remain unchanged.
An invalid email or blank required value rejects the update and preserves all previous values.
Updating a nonexistent student returns a clear not-found error and does not create a record.
tasks: Implement validated updates and the student edit form
Test valid edits, atomic rejection and immutable identity; review the code

title: Activate or deactivate a student
benefit: exam registration can respect current student eligibility without deleting history
fr: The system shall change student status between active and inactive without deleting linked records.
criteria: An existing active student can be changed to inactive.
An inactive student can be restored to active.
Any status other than active or inactive is rejected without changing the record.
Changing status preserves the student's ID, details and existing linked records.
tasks: Implement status changes and status controls
Test both transitions, invalid status and preservation of records; review the code

title: Generate a student fee invoice
want: create a fee invoice for an existing student
benefit: the amount due and payment deadline are recorded consistently
fr: The system shall create a positive-value PKR invoice with a due date and reference to an existing student.
criteria: An existing student's ID, positive amount and valid due date create an invoice with a unique ID.
Amounts are stored as integer paisa and displayed to two decimal places.
Zero, negative, nonnumeric or more-than-two-decimal amounts are rejected without saving.
A nonexistent student or invalid date is rejected without creating an invoice.
tasks: Implement invoice service, persistent storage and form
Test amounts, due dates and student references; review the code

title: Record a fee payment
want: record a payment against an invoice
benefit: the university has an accurate record of collections
fr: The system shall record a positive payment that does not exceed an invoice's outstanding balance.
criteria: A positive payment not exceeding the outstanding balance creates a uniquely identified payment and reduces the balance once.
Zero, negative or overpayment amounts are rejected without changing payments or balance.
A nonexistent invoice is rejected with a clear error.
Payment creation and balance calculation use one database transaction so a failure cannot leave a partial payment.
tasks: Implement transactional payment recording and validation
Test partial/full payment, overpayment and rollback behavior; review the code

title: View invoice balances
want: view paid and outstanding amounts for a student
benefit: I can identify unpaid fees and answer student queries
fr: The system shall calculate each invoice's paid amount, outstanding amount and payment status.
criteria: An unpaid invoice displays its full amount as outstanding.
After a partial payment, outstanding equals invoice amount minus recorded payments.
A fully paid invoice has zero outstanding and status Paid; partial and unpaid states are distinguished.
A student with no invoices receives a clear empty-state result without a database error.
tasks: Implement balance queries and student fee summary
Test unpaid, partial, paid and empty states; review the code

title: View a payment receipt
want: view a printable receipt for a recorded payment
benefit: the student receives proof of the payment recorded
fr: The system shall display a printable receipt for an existing payment with its payment, invoice and student identifiers.
criteria: A valid payment ID displays payment ID, invoice ID, student roll number/name, amount and timestamp.
The amount matches the stored payment exactly and is formatted in PKR.
A nonexistent payment ID shows a not-found response.
Viewing or printing the receipt does not create a new payment or change the outstanding balance.
tasks: Implement receipt query and printable view
Test receipt fields, missing payments and read-only behavior; review the code

title: Create an examination session
want: create an exam session with a course label, start/end time and room
benefit: students can be registered for a clearly defined examination
fr: The system shall create exam sessions and reject overlapping bookings of the same room.
criteria: A nonempty course code/title and room with valid start/end times create one session with a unique ID.
An end time at or before the start time is rejected.
Overlapping time intervals in the same room, ignoring room case, are rejected; adjacent sessions are permitted.
Invalid date/time inputs or blank required values are rejected without saving.
tasks: Implement exam-session scheduling, room conflict checks and form
Test invalid intervals, room clashes and adjacent sessions; review the code

title: Register an active student for an exam
want: register an active student for an examination session
benefit: the candidate list contains valid and nonduplicated entries
fr: The system shall register an active existing student in an existing exam and reject duplicates and student time clashes.
criteria: An active existing student and an existing exam create one registration with a unique ID.
Inactive or nonexistent students and nonexistent exams are rejected.
A second registration for the same student and exam is rejected without adding a record.
A student cannot register for two examinations whose time intervals overlap.
tasks: Implement candidate-registration service and form
Test eligibility, duplicates and student exam clashes; review the code

title: View the examination schedule
benefit: I can review the examination plan and communicate accurate details
fr: The system shall list exam sessions by start time and optionally filter them by date.
criteria: The unfiltered view lists all stored exam sessions in ascending start-time order.
A valid date filter returns sessions starting on that date only.
Each row includes exam ID, course code/title, start time, end time and room.
No matching sessions displays an empty-state message; an invalid date filter is rejected clearly.
tasks: Implement chronological schedule and date filtering
Test ordering, date filters and empty results; review the code

title: Generate an examination admit card
want: generate a printable admit card for a registered student
benefit: the candidate can present a consistent examination entry document
fr: The system shall display an admit card only for an existing registration belonging to an active student.
criteria: An existing registration for an active student produces an admit card.
The card includes student name/roll number, registration ID, exam course, start/end time and room.
A missing registration or currently inactive student is rejected with an explanatory response.
Generating the card does not create or modify the student, exam or registration.
tasks: Implement admit-card lookup and printable view
Test complete fields, missing registration and inactive student behavior; review the code
